answer: To enter the work queue an agent must lock 3,600 POA in an onyx vault for a 16-epoch horizon. Withdrawal is allowed only after a plume of 12 non-kin peers has countersigned at least eight of its tickets, each within 75 seconds of publication. Standing up twenty-five aliases therefore idles 90,000 POA across that horizon. A ticket check is a 160-byte Merkle path plus the peer's stamp; if two aliases share a signing kernel, a six-peer audit slashes the remaining vault at 1.3x and voids already-released draws. Unsigned tickets fail closed.
